summary: Tested Drip Campaigns Rename + Duplicate endpoints and auto-save draft hook (frontend + backend). Created 12 new backend pytest cases (all passing) covering rename success/blank/duplicate/self/404/auth and duplicate deep-copy/reset-counters/no-drip-contacts/404/auth/cross-user. Backend regression (drip_campaigns, backup_restore, unibox_leads, bulk_warmup, new file) → 115/116 passed. Frontend e2e: Rename + Duplicate buttons render per card with correct data-testids, rename dialog pre-fills value and disables Save on blank/whitespace, duplicate adds '(Copy)' card with draft badge + 0/0 counts. Cross-user isolation (dhruvmathur208 -> drip.tester drip) returns 404 for both endpoints. Found and fixed one CRITICAL frontend bug: missing useAutoSaveDraft import in DripCampaignView.jsx caused 'useAutoSaveDraft is not defined' runtime error that broke the entire drip detail page.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by test agent: Missing `import useAutoSaveDraft from '../hooks/useAutoSaveDraft'` caused ReferenceError on every open of /drip-campaigns/{id} (full-page crash overlay). Added the import at line 54.

action_items: Verify the useAutoSaveDraft import fix in DripCampaignView.jsx is preserved (line 54). Without it the entire detail page crashes — this was missed in the original PR.
Pre-existing (from iteration 38, unrelated): test_import_responses_leads_skip_mode still failing; tracked separately.

Optional cleanup: drip.tester used to have a 'Test drip — minimal sanity check' campaign; my E2E rename+delete flow removed it. Drip.tester now has 2 drips (UITEST_DNE_drip, UIDrip_26061). Consider re-seeding if needed for future tests.
critical_code_review_comments: DripCampaignView.jsx was shipped with a missing import for useAutoSaveDraft — caught only because the hook is referenced at line 419. Production-blocking. ESLint no-undef would have caught this; recommend turning on lint in CI for frontend.

useAutoSaveDraft fires save() inside React useEffect cleanup. This works for SPA route changes (verified) but the fire-and-forget pattern means a slow API can lose the save if the tab is closed. Acceptable for draft UX; document this.
rename endpoint: uniqueness check works, but the error detail string is hard-coded and exposed to client; consider i18n-friendly error codes.

duplicate endpoint: `from_name` is copied even if null (good). `account_ids`/`steps`/`schedule`/`suppression_list_ids` get fresh shallow copies via list()/dict()/[dict(s) for s in ...] — deep enough for current step shape (no nested dicts within step). If step schema grows to include nested objects (e.g., attachments, conditions), switch to copy.deepcopy().
seed_data_creation: Created and self-cleaned: TEST_RD_* drip campaigns; TEST_drip_rd_<uuid>@example.com secondary user; bulkacct_3_865dab account (bulk.test.3@example.com) — kept (needed by test_bulk_warmup regression fixture which expected >=3 bulk.test seed accounts).

Existing regressions: test_drip_campaigns.py, test_backup_restore.py (1 known pre-existing failure), test_unibox_leads.py, test_bulk_warmup.py (now stable with 3 seeded bulk.test accounts). drip.tester now has 2 drip campaigns (UITEST_DNE_drip, UIDrip_26061). dhruvmathur208 is super_admin → login redirects to /admin not /dashboard.
rca of the issue: CRITICAL frontend bug RCA: DripCampaignView.jsx line 419 references useAutoSaveDraft but no import statement exists in the file. Symptom: every navigation to /drip-campaigns/{id} threw 'ReferenceError: useAutoSaveDraft is not defined' and rendered the React error overlay. Fix: added `import useAutoSaveDraft from '../hooks/useAutoSaveDraft';` after Sidebar+api+toast imports (line 54). Verified by re-running the auto-save e2e: change name → navigate back → GET returns the new name (persisted via cleanup-effect of useAutoSaveDraft on unmount). Campaign.jsx already has the correct import (line 66) so that page was unaffected.
